AEROSPACE SANDBOX
Juno: New Origins is a 3D aerospace sandbox where players can use customizable parts to construct and test rockets, planes, cars, or anything they can imagine in an environment with realistic physics across land, sea, air, and space.

CAREER MODE + TECH TREE
Take control of your own aerospace company and earn money and tech points as you progress through the game. Complete contracts to earn money, and discover a mixture of hand-crafted and procedural contracts that offer countless hours of new gameplay. RESIZE AND RESHAPE PARTS

DESIGN ROCKET AND JET ENGINES

The engine's performance affects its visuals in flight too as shown by the exhaust's expansion or contraction based on its interplay with the atmospheric pressure. If the player increases the bet, when ready the player taps Play and the face down card is revealed. If the card lies between the other two cards the player wins. If it is either higher or lower than the range given by the initial two cards the player loses.

Place your ante to start. You win when the hole card is in between the two face down cards. Tap Pass to get new cards. Tap Play to risk the bet. Tap the Reset Icon to start a new game. Good Luck!

The rules for Acey-Duecy vary somewhat.  This game is played using a common set of rules.  Before any cards are dealt the player must decide on an ante. Then, two cards are dealt face-up and the player can increase the bet after seeing the first two cards. The player can double the bet if they think it is likely that the third card will be between the first two cards.  As in most card games there is no option to change the ante after cards have been dealt.
